title: Puzzle Bundle Terminology Cleanup
description: Clean puzzle bundle terminology across 2d/3d/5d: NodeKind/ObjectKind/PartKind, KindCatalogBundle, no Board/Scene/Topology/Kit/Line prefixes in bundles.
summary: Cleaned puzzle bundle terminology across 2d/3d/5d: renamed Board*KindCatalog* to NodeKind/HandleKind/EdgeKind/WireKind and KindCatalogBundle in puzzle/2d; renamed *KindCatalogEntry to *Kind in puzzle/3d; added puzzle 5d KindCatalogBundle with PartKind/GripKind/FastenerKind/RopeKind plus projection helpers; migrated fixture JSON keys (grips/parts/defaultRopeKind) and builtin ids (port, wire.link, cable.link); rebuilt WASM setKindCatalogsJson.
